t: Certification - Receivables Management Association International
s: October 1, 2025 - Effective January 1, 2025, all debt buying company members must earn the Certified Receivables Business (CRB) designation regardless of whether they are purchasing or selling debt. New members that joined in 2024 have one (1) year to get their business certified. Collection law firms, third party collection agencies, and vendors may voluntarily seek the CRB or Certified Receivables Vendor (CRV) designation but are not required to do so to maintain RMAI membership.
